selector.rationale: The presence of a reddish hematomalike plaque with a brownish peripheral border, along with immunohistochemical and histologic findings such as poorly defined vascular proliferation, small dilated vascular channels, and prominent hemosiderin deposits, supports this diagnosis without contradiction.

rejected.label: Stewart-Treves syndrome
rejected.why: Lack of strong supporting evidence and absence of lymphedema history

rejected.label: Angiosarcoma
rejected.why: Contradicted by low proliferation index and absence of cellular pleomorphism

rejected.label: Kaposi's sarcoma
rejected.why: Negative HIV status and lack of characteristic histologic features
